The '''TRHA-300 Control Harness''' was manufactured by [[LeisureMech Enterprises/Legends|Leisure Mechanicals]]. It allowed riders to [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetically]] control racing [[Bird/Legends|avians]] such as the [[tranthebar mountain ripper]].
